tasks.description:
Make a host hold revoke nothing on the Community server (apps/community). Lands after the host hold (#2036, origin/flow/dor-2255-host-hold, migration 0014); if #2036 is still open when this is built, fold this change into it before merge. No migration, no wire schema change.

### Why
Today `action: 'hold'` in `routes/host-lifecycle.ts` calls `revokeTenantAccess` (host/communities.ts: revokes invitations, deletes pending_admissions, cancels unconsumed pairings, revokes connection grants and agent credentials, deactivates agents) and release revives nothing. Every member write path already refuses a held community with `423 COMMUNITY_HELD`, so the revocation protects nothing and costs every member a re-pair, every owner a re-enrollment and new invitations.

### Changes
1. `routes/host-lifecycle.ts`: the `hold` branch stops calling `revokeTenantAccess`. It still sets lifecycle='held', held_from_state, held_at, deletion_notice_at, bumps lifecycle_version, writes the host audit row. Replace the comment with: a hold refuses growth by lifecycle; credentials stay so the community resumes on release. Release code is unchanged. Suspend (from active, archived, held), owner archive, owner deletion request (including from held), host-started deletion, and community takedown still revoke. Resume of a suspension that started from held returns to held with credentials still revoked.
2. `data.ts`: remove `readOnlyWord`. The three grant predicates (requireConnectionGrant ~L199, assertPrincipalCurrent ~L341, lockPrincipalAuthority ~L403) keep `AND ($5::text <> 'archived' OR history_only)` but $5 is now the stored `communities.lifecycle`, so history_only is required only for owner-archived communities. The surrounding lifecycle check `lifecycle !== 'active' && !(isReadOnlyLifecycle(lifecycle) && scope === 'read')` is unchanged, so a kept grant can read only. Agent path needs no predicate change (it checks agents.active, which the hold no longer clears).
3. `routes/pairings.ts`, `GET /me/connection-access` and `GET /me/grants`: capabilities depend on lifecycle:
   - active: read = scopes has read; post = scopes has post && !history_only; enrollAgent = scopes has enroll-agent && !history_only; stream = !history_only; reported lifecycle 'active'.
   - held: read = scopes has read; post, enrollAgent, stream = false; reported lifecycle 'archived'.
   - archived: unchanged (only history_only grants live); post/enrollAgent/stream false; reported 'archived'.
   The response must parse with the unchanged strict `CommunityConnectionAccessSchema` (refinement "Archived access is history-only"). The grant list keeps real `scopes`.
   Pairing approval while held stays as today (approved as {read}, history_only), and the approval page says: "The community is on hold, so this connection can only read. Connect again after the hold ends to post."
4. `routes/events.ts`: the live-stream access check stops joining on `co.lifecycle='active'`; it selects the lifecycle. Close decision: active → continue; held or archived → `closed` reason `archived`; credential gone or any other lifecycle → `closed` reason `removed`. Opening a stream while held answers `423 COMMUNITY_HELD` before any event.
5. `routes/invites.ts`: while held an existing invitation is not revoked; `POST /invites/preview` returns it with the held state (page text: "This community is on hold. You can join when the hold ends."); preflight, bind, redeem, and pending-admission completion answer `423 COMMUNITY_HELD` and write nothing; `POST /invites` answers 423 (unchanged); revoking an invitation is allowed; expiry keeps running.
6. Agents: enrollment, reactivation, recovery answer 423 while held (unchanged); an enrolled agent reads (200) and posting answers 423.
7. Browser: the invitation page and pairing approval page sentences above (writing-for-humans).
8. Amend `specs/community-host-operator-api/02-specification.md` Hold → Credentials bullet to "Entering a hold revokes nothing; see specs/community-hold-keeps-access/." and replace its AC "Holding revokes grants and agent credentials; release … revives none of them" with a pointer to this spec's AC-1/AC-2; add a changelog line. ADR 260923-121712 Status gains "Amended by 260923-214401".
9. Docs: OPERATIONS.md (hold keeps connections/agents/invitations; suspend to cut access; holds made before this change keep their revocations), API.md (capabilities while held, stream close reason, invitations while held), docs/guides/communities.mdx one sentence for people, changelog fragment.

### Acceptance criteria (real Postgres, hold fixtures from #2036, purpose comment on each test)
- AC-1: seed community A with grant G (read, post, enroll-agent), agent X with live credential, unexpired invitation I, a pending admission, unconsumed pairing P. Hold A. Every revoked_at/cancelled_at/active column of those rows is unchanged and the pending_admissions row remains. Fails if the hold still revokes.
- AC-2: while held, G reads history and downloads a file (200); G posts → 423 COMMUNITY_HELD; X reads 200, posts 423; stream open with G → 423; agent enrollment with G → 423; connection access with G = lifecycle archived, {read:true, post:false, enrollAgent:false, stream:false}, parses with CommunityConnectionAccessSchema. Release A; with no re-pair/re-enroll: G posts 201, X posts 201, G opens a stream 200, access returns active with all capabilities true, I redeems 201.
- AC-3: a stream opened by G before the hold receives `closed` reason `archived` (not `removed`).
- AC-4: during the hold, preview of I returns it with held state; preflight/bind/redeem answer 423 and insert no members, invite_uses, or community_handles row; POST /invites 423; revoking I allowed.
- AC-5: suspend from held revokes G, X's credential and I; resume returns to held still revoked; host deletion from held and owner deletion request from held revoke; owner archive revokes.
- AC-6: P approved during the hold yields a {read} history_only grant that cannot post after release (403).
- AC-7: community B (active) is unchanged by every hold and release of A.
- The existing hold/lifecycle matrix tests from #2036 change their "hold revokes" assertion to AC-1; tenancy isolation suites stay green.

tasks.description:
Make the DorkOS app (apps/server/src/services/communities/remote/) notice a released hold and stop replaying posts refused during one. Independent of task 1.1 in code; only meaningful once 1.1 ships.

### Current behaviour (traced)
- `RemoteCommunityPairingService.verify()` (pairing-service.ts ~156-183) re-fetches `/me/connection-access` only when list()/status() are called (UI asks for connection status). No timer. A 401 marks the connection reconnect-required; nothing treats archived as terminal.
- `remote-room-subscription-runtime.ts` reconcile() runs every 5 s from stored lastKnown; when effective.stream is false it stops the room; when it becomes true again it resubscribes.
- `community-adapter-outbox-delivery.ts` deliveryFailure() treats 401/403/409/413/415 as permanent and everything else, including 423, as retry with backoff until the outbox item expires.

### Changes
1. A timer in the remote connection runtime (whichever module owns runtime timers; wire it where the subscription runtime is started) re-runs `verify()` every 5 minutes for each connection whose stored `lastKnown.lifecycle` is `archived`. Connections in any other state are not polled by this timer. When access returns active with stream: true, the existing reconcile resubscribes joined rooms. A 401 marks reconnect-required as verify() already does. Stop the timer on shutdown; inject the clock for tests.
2. `deliveryFailure()`: a 423 whose remote code is COMMUNITY_HELD, COMMUNITY_ARCHIVED, or COMMUNITY_DELETION_PENDING is permanent, with the read-only reason already mapped in `apps/server/src/routes/remote-community-refusal.ts` ("The host has put this community on hold. You can read it, but no one can post. Its owner can still export it." for COMMUNITY_HELD). Any other 423 keeps retrying.

### Acceptance criteria
- AC-8: with a fake clock, a connection whose stored lastKnown.lifecycle is archived calls the access route again at 5 minutes and not before; when the fake Community returns active with stream: true, the subscription runtime resubscribes the joined rooms on its next reconcile. A connection with lifecycle active is never polled by this timer. Fails if release goes unnoticed without a person opening connection status.
- AC-9: an outbox item refused with 423 COMMUNITY_HELD is marked failed at once with the read-only reason; after the fake server starts accepting posts the item is not delivered. A 423 with another code still retries.
- TSDoc on new exports; `pnpm --filter @dorkos/server typecheck` and lint pass.
